A Letter from Vedu November 2026

Dearest Angeline,

Happy Birthday! From the nervous calm of the Chemistry board exam start to the moment I finally asked you on May 2, 2026, you have brought a lightness into my days that I never knew how much I needed.

Whether you’re commanding a football pitch with effortless energy, filling a room with your voice, laughing at my terrible jokes as Angie Pangie, or patiently putting up with Vedu turning everything into a little coding project, you make ordinary moments feel unforgettable.

Thank you for being my favorite princess with a frying pan, my favorite singer, and my absolute favorite Cutappa. Here’s to your brightest, happiest year yet, BUBU — may every dream you chase feel as light as a floating lantern and as steady as us.

Always yours, Vedu
